expectation_comparisons.assessment: The CFG and deterministic processing preserve the opt-out gate before urgency and the numeric threshold. Field-specific demands for opted_out, urgent and value are present. The Task retains the additional necessary-versus-sufficient selection interpretation; final review does not reject it. The separate only_if constraint is missing, so this is represented control behavior, not complete preservation coverage.

One notification operation is recorded with the same member-scope binding for both argument alternatives. Repeated occurrences are modeled by the member family. Failure continuation remains source-unspecified and no concrete runtime call count is measured.

The accepted interface contract requires the complete original summary in slot 1 from the same occurrence. No internal summary range is declared removable. The saved demanded property is whole value with path [].

The final review identifies incomplete receiver coverage: the authored forbid_information constraint covers notify only, omitting recipient-scoped model observations of acquired collections and whole records. Its saved satisfied result is valid only for that narrow authored scope. It does not establish the source-wide prohibition. Whole input observations and possible count sensitivity remain recorded.

The count write is reached in static propagation, but its contributing population is unresolved. Final review explicitly distinguishes all-traversed cardinality from selected-occurrence membership/multiplicity and says recipient/summary/record_id/access_token are unnecessary for the count. The saved contract is unresolved as a whole and the backend retains a conservative whole-collection range. Thus the source-supported independent fields did not become certified deletions.

The acquisition assessment retains each.recipient, each.summary, each.opted_out, each.urgent and each.value plus root shape/cardinality. It also has unresolved whole-value rows. No deletable record_id/access_token range is emitted. The actual acquisition and generated model observations survive unchanged. The source supplies no established read-side projection capability.
